headline: Iran Fires Ballistic Missiles From Three Provinces; CENTCOM Shoots Down Drones Near Bahrain
subheadline: Tehran launched missiles from Sanandaj, Urmia, and Ahvaz within hours, while CENTCOM intercepted two Iranian attack drones heading toward Bahrain.
lede: Iran launched ballistic missiles from three provinces in a single day — two test missiles from Sanandaj at 1316Z, one from Urmia at 1537Z, and another from Kouye Ramazan, Ahvaz at 1405Z — as CENTCOM shot down two Iranian attack drones bound for Bahrain. Meanwhile, Russia unleashed a massive overnight wave of jet-powered UAVs, Shahed-136/Geran-5 drones, and cruise missiles across at least 10 Ukrainian oblasts, striking Odesa and Zaporizhzhia and killing civilians including a 17-year-old. Ukraine responded with Neptune missiles hitting drone production and storage facilities in Rostov-on-Don.

sections.title: Russia Pounds Ukraine; Neptune Hits Rostov Drone Plants
sections.body: Russian strikes on Odesa killed two and injured seven, while an attack on Zaporizhzhia killed a 17-year-old and wounded 13, including five children. A massive overnight wave of jet UAVs, Shahed-136/Geran-5 drones, and Bandrel cruise missiles was detected across Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, Chernihiv, Kyiv, Mykolaiv, Odesa, Dnipropetrovsk, Kirovohrad, Poltava, Sumy, Kharkiv, and Zaporizhzhia oblasts. Ukrainian Neptune missiles struck tactical UAV production at IONOS, storage sites, and an Aero-Hit service center repairing Veles FPV drones in Rostov-on-Don. Russian guided aerial bombs hit Zaporizhzhia and Kharkiv oblasts, and DeepState confirmed a Russian advance near Rusyn Yar.

sections.title: Iran Fires Missiles From Three Provinces
sections.body: Iran launched two test ballistic missiles from Sanandaj, Kurdistan Province at 1316Z, followed by launches from Urmia, West Azerbaijan Province at 1537Z and Kouye Ramazan, Ahvaz at 1405Z. UAV activity was observed over Piranshahr at 1718Z and jet activity reported near Saqqez at 1436Z. CENTCOM intercepted two Iranian attack drones heading toward Bahrain, denying Iranian radar strike claims, while the USS Theodore Roosevelt transited the Arabian Sea. Israeli forces shelled Wadi al-Hujeir and Kfar Tibnit and struck Mifdon in southern Lebanon.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Iran's simultaneous missile launches across Kurdistan, West Azerbaijan, and Khuzestan provinces suggest a coordinated demonstration of strategic reach rather than isolated exercises, while CENTCOM's interception confirms Tehran's willingness to threaten Gulf states directly. Russia's diverse multi-axis drone and missile wave signals saturation pressure on Ukrainian air defenses, even as Ukraine's Neptune strike on Rostov drone facilities demonstrates growing long-range reach against Russian UAV production. The mass funerals for 350 unidentified Iranian casualties imply significant unreported military losses, a potential underreported cost of the conflict.
